scenes.title: 남은 시간은 사흘
scenes.summary: Sunday morning in the cafe corner: Hannah and Tessa calm Arthur down and divide the tasks needed before Wednesday at three.

scenes.title: 초록색 방명록
scenes.summary: Hannah, Evelyn, and Arthur turn to May thirty years ago in the green guest book and learn why the Friday concert stopped.

scenes.title: 피아노 액션 내부 들여다보기
scenes.summary: Graham opens the front panel of the upright piano with Evelyn and Caleb and spots a slipped brass hinge pin on middle D.

scenes.title: 비눗물, 양동이, 그리고 햇살
scenes.summary: Hannah, Caleb, and Owen wash thirty years of dust off the tall arched sunroom glass with warm soapy water.

scenes.title: 바깥쪽의 뻑뻑한 덧문
scenes.summary: Outside in the courtyard, Graham, Hannah, and Arthur oil the rusty hinges on Room Nine's exterior wooden shutters and swing them wide open.

scenes.title: 빠져 있는 열여섯 마디
scenes.summary: At dusk on Sunday, Evelyn hums and pencils two possible endings for the waltz while Hannah and Caleb listen over hot mint tea.

scenes.title: 카페 메뉴 시식하기
scenes.summary: In the kitchen corner, Tessa asks brothers Caleb and Owen to taste two versions of her Wednesday cafe soup and lemon tart.

scenes.title: 자정에 울린 천둥
scenes.summary: While closing up on Sunday night, Hannah and Graham hear sudden thunder and rush to pull the newly sanded shutters under cover before a downpour.
